caption: The drawing depicts an architectural element resembling a corbel or bracket, centrally placed on a light beige background. The object is rendered in shades of light brown, beige, and muted orange, suggesting a stone or terracotta material. The corbel is composed of a rectangular block with two vertical, parallel supports underneath, each decorated with a circular floral motif at the top and stylized leaf patterns running vertically down the length. The upper section features a flat horizontal top with an ornamental border containing geometric and foliate designs. The lines are finely detailed, and the overall composition is symmetrical, with careful shading and crosshatching to suggest texture and dimensionality. In the lower right corner, there is an inscription that reads "W. RIEGSHOFER."
title: Architectural Detail (Wall Brackets)
